notes.title: ARPG Overhaul!
notes.content:
[b]Big Major Update:[/b]
[i]Game is no longer a survivor-like but an arpg.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150539/c37dd2614805247b9c44bdaeba98f61f9fdc94dd.png[/img]

You can now buy/sell items, gear, weapons and abilities in shops or pick them up from an enemy or crate drop. 

Loot has 4 rarities: Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary.

Weapons have Damage Types and there are Damage Type Resistances.

Some abilities do damage based off weapon values.

Bosses and enemies are now fully proceduralized so you can see any combination of an enemy.

Weapons, Gear and other loot roll random modifiers when rare or better and also receive improvements.

Shops are scattered throughout the map.

Lore Boxes are added, hit them and see what they say. Provides story to the game.

notes.title: Fake "Devlog"
notes.content:
In light of the game entering the discovery queue, I will have progress posts in this "news" format as everyone can see it easily and you do not have to navigate to the steam discussion.

As outlined in the game's description, I am planning to change the game into more of a loot grinder in a random generated dungeon/map, although, I'see how to do the whole dungeon theme with the scifi-modern assets.

Currently working on an inventory system and on the loot generation system.
The loot is probably going to be divided into either: common, rare, epic OR common, rare, epic, legendary.

Next will probably be making the game playable with loot and the inventory without the dungeon generation, Risk of rain 2 style, where you activate a teleporter to trigger a boss fight. This involves re-balancing and adding more or changing existing enemies.



Then a UI beautification, and then probably an update.
